verify.note: Closed 2026-09-29 (ADR-1642). Measures the consequence from the code, not a list: every processor signal the code carries (seven package.json dependencies, seven hosts in lib, app and components, tests excluded) must be named on the privacy page and in docs/APP-STORE-PRIVACY.md, so a new vendor the policy does not name fails it; web-push, navigator.geolocation and getUserMedia in the code require push notifications, the device position and the camera on the page; no paragraph pairs hello@ with export or deletion; the page links /settings#account (or the redirecting /settings/account), and that section of /settings renders DownloadData and DeleteAccount, whose buttons call downloadMyData and deleteAccountAction; no em dash; the inventory points at the backlog in its first 25 lines, maps every Apple data type with Linked, Tracking and Purpose columns, and carries age rating inputs. Fails on main (bc1913405) at the first arm. Mutation-fired: 28 of 28 arm mutations fail it. Exits 1 with the file name when a wired file is gone.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1642). PREMISE HELD at bc1913405 (main): app/privacy/page.tsx (Last updated June 23, 2026) told members to email hello@frequencylocal.com for "a full data export or account deletion", though both are self-serve at /settings#account (H2-5, LIVE-549); it named Supabase, Vercel, Google, Stripe and Resend only, and said nothing of push, location, the camera or SMS consent. WHAT CHANGED. (1) The policy's factual sections only: section 2 adds location (home point, live location once per opt-in, a geofenced claim checked and not saved, an IP city lookup to center maps), camera and photos (the QR scanner decodes on the device; card and poster photos go to Vera), push subscriptions, phone number and SMS consent evidence, payments, Vera's memory, and usage data tied to the account only with analytics on and purged after 90 days; section 3 adds three uses; section 4 names Supabase, Vercel, Anthropic, Sentry, Twilio, Resend, Stripe, Upstash, Google, OpenFreeMap, Photon, Nominatim, ipapi.co, Recraft and the browsers' push services with what each receives; section 7 links /settings#account for Download my data and Delete account, says what deletion removes and keeps, and how to turn push, texts and analytics off. Structure, voice, Google Limited Use and contact unchanged; Last updated September 29, 2026; a CHANGELOG line. (2) docs/APP-STORE-PRIVACY.md maps every App Store data type (collected, linked, tracking: none, purpose, evidence), lists each processor with what it receives, and records the age rating inputs (18+ per the terms, user-generated content with report and block, chat, in-person meeting and an opt-in romance lane, unrestricted web links, wellness topics, no gambling or ads). Owner and counsel review items are in the PR. No migration.
